address: Elarnia Hotel & Spa, ul. Morenowa 33, Puszczykowo, 62-040, Poland
bio: On the edge of the Wielkopolski National Park, yet only 30 minutes from the centre of Poznań, sits this restaurant inside the thatched Elarnia Hotel & Spa. The dining room’s stylish black-and-white design mirrors the minimalist look of the hotel, while the kitchen blends the modern and the classic with a lightness of touch. Expect colourful dishes offering an array of flavours and textures, from chefs who know their craft and respect their ingredients.
